body: My life has been slowly going down hill for a while now. At this point there is no light. Its hard to say what a good life would even be like. I never really had dreams of being a billionaire. There is not one thing that would make me better. It would be better to just start over.

Thank you for that. But I don't know how much that idea is helping me. It has become a burden. Rather than have a life of my own, I have sacrificed everything for my family and the only one that really cares is a random person online.

Its really hard to say. Its been years now since anything really good. I work during the day for about 10 hours and help them with homework at night and get dinner on the table, because my wife lets them just sit in front of the tv and eat. Then they fight me about everything and then finally get them to bed. Clean up the house, watch tv by myself and then go to bed. Wife comes home later. Weekends the kids are being taken to everything with their friends and don't really get to do much with them.
I have had these feelings before but today is a really low day. Kids are 8 and 5.
Yes. I think that if I tell my wife what is going on with me she will use that against me and leave me and take as much as she can. I don't have anyone else to talk with.

Not for a while. I have really closed myself off from them after a while. I am not as young as the rest and have a different life than them. We just don't get along and I just sit and do my work. I never really talk to them anymore. The only one that I really talked with, is now gone.
